correctness.summary: The path-blow-up formula partitions endpoint pairs into distinct-layer and same-layer cases. The tapered-layer recurrence gives the stated closed form, and subtraction from the published G_{3,q} formula gives 10*3^(q-2)-15>0. Direct shortest-path counts agree in finite checks.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2026 primary source explicitly leaves finding a construction larger than G_{3,n/3} as Problem 14. Searches of the exact invariant and equivalent layered/shortest-path terminology did not locate the arbitrary path-blow-up formula or the tapered family. Recency and indexing latency remain residual risks.

value.summary: The construction resolves the construction side of an explicit open problem on an infinite sequence of orders and improves the prior leading lower-bound constant by the factor 121/81. The general path-blow-up identity is also reusable.

limitations: No optimality claim is made for the tapered family among all path blow-ups or all connected graphs.
Orders not divisible by three are not optimized here.
The universal upper bound is not improved.
The invariant is recent, so differently phrased or incompletely indexed follow-up work remains possible.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
